surfaces.cards: bg-white border border-[#163A5F]/5 shadow-sm hover:shadow-lg hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300
surfaces.header: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-[#163A5F]/5 sticky top-0 z-50

components_strategy.buttons: rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-semibold transition-colors duration-200. Primary: bg-[#2CB1BC] text-white hover:bg-[#22929B]. Secondary: bg-white text-[#163A5F] border border-[#163A5F]/20 hover:bg-[#F7F9FC].
components_strategy.inputs: Shadcn components heavily styled to match. rounded-xl bg-white border-[#163A5F]/10 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2CB1BC]/50
components_strategy.navigation: Desktop visible links, mobile hamburger. Active states with subtle #2CB1BC underline or dot.
components_strategy.badges: bg-[#F4B942]/10 text-[#163A5F] font-bold rounded-full px-4 py-1 text-sm

animation_and_motion.page_transitions: opacity fade in, slight upward translate on scroll for sections

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text-[#163A5F] meets APCA standards against #F7F9FC and #FFFFFF. White text against #2CB1BC and #163A5F is AA compliant.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a multi-page routing structure using React Router (if applicable) or handle view states if SPA.
Use Outfit for Headings and DM Sans for Body font. Install via Google Fonts.
For the hero section, avoid a flat overlay; use a gentle gradient overlay or soft glassmorphism card for text to ensure readability over the background image.
Use lucide-react for all icons, keeping stroke width around 1.5 or 2 for a clean, modern look.
Include the data-testid attributes on all buttons, links, accordion triggers, and form elements.
Keep spacing extremely generous, especially between major sections (py-24 or py-32).
Apply the rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl styles to images, cards, and buttons to evoke the approachable 'Airbnb' style.
The footer should be dark (bg-[#163A5F]) to provide contrast from the rest of the light theme.
For the Team section, use a grid layout with the provided portrait for the Clinical Director placeholder.
Ensure all Shadcn components (if used) are stripped of the default 'Vercel' look and styled to match these guidelines.
